verdict.rationale: A community report confirms Meilisearch's telemetry can be disabled with the MEILI_NO_ANALYTICS setting, so a user can opt out. The same report criticizes that collection is on by default (opt-out rather than opt-in), and this single, older mention is the only evidence. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the telemetry opt-out (env var or CLI flag), what data is collected, whether Meilisearch Cloud offers an opt-out, and recent independent corroboration.
